name: governor_act
description: Wren's PROACTIVE control loop (R01, gate-respecting) — survey -> DECIDE -> DELEGATE -> FOLLOW-UP, not survey -> observe. In one call it reads the deep command_deck (per-CEO load, global WIP, backlog, blocked, stale), follows up her own outstanding delegations so none are forgotten, then DECIDES what a governor should actually do given the real state and acts on it through delegate_task. If the council is SATURATED at the WIP ceiling it does NOT pile on new work — it earmarks the highest-value work as pending and reports the finish-first / unblock / reap recommendation. If there is FREE WIP capacity it delegates real work into the slot(s): first an unowned OPEN backlog task (drives completion, no new sprawl), else a fresh governor_scan finding turned into a new assigned task with a verifier and a relay ping to the least-loaded online worker. Every action runs through delegate_task so the per-CEO cap and global WIP ceiling are respected and every handoff is logged. Params: max_actions (default 1), dry_run (plan only), notify. It flips no gate and forces nothing onto a jammed board.
authored_by: Claude for Wren (governor upgrade — proactive control loop; additive, touches no mind/persona file)
